findings.title: invoice.paid top-up handler uses checkout session lookup instead of invoice metadata
findings.spec_requirement: Note #4: grants one-off credits using the organization_id and stripe_price_lookup_key from the invoice metadata
findings.evidence: stripe_webhook_handler_job.rb lines 182-191: uses Stripe::Checkout::Session.list(payment_intent: object.payment_intent) to find the checkout session, then calls ApplyAiCreditPurchase.call(session: checkout_session, kind: :one_off). This achieves the same result via a different mechanism (checkout session's line items provide the price/lookup_key).
findings.classification: Spec-compliant alternative approach. The invoice_creation.invoice_data.metadata IS set correctly in purchase_top_up (organization_ai_credit_purchases_controller.rb lines 89-97). The handler correctly detects ai_credit_pack_top_up from invoice metadata. The credit grant path via checkout session lookup is functionally equivalent and reuses the existing apply_one_off path.
findings.recommendation: Report only. The approach is sound and avoids duplicating credit-granting logic.

findings.title: CREDIT_PACKS_BY_LOOKUP_KEY missing 'name' field from spec
findings.spec_requirement: Note #9B-1: Four packs with name field (e.g., 'Credit Pack Top-Up - Small')
findings.evidence: organization_ai_credit_purchase.rb CREDIT_PACKS_BY_LOOKUP_KEY has kind and credits/credits_per_period but no 'name' field. Spec shows names like 'Credit Pack Top-Up - Small'.
findings.classification: Pre-existing from previous QA runs. The name field is not used anywhere in the codebase -- pack display names come from Stripe product names via the prices API.

findings.title: handle_credit_pack_invoice_paid does not update subscription period dates or status
findings.spec_requirement: Note #9B-5: When invoice.paid arrives, sets status and period dates via existing if existing branch at lines 443-482
findings.evidence: handle_credit_pack_invoice_paid (stripe_webhook_handler_job.rb lines 389-402) only updates amount_cents_paid and currency, then delegates to ApplyAiCreditPurchase.call. It does NOT update subscription_current_period_start, subscription_current_period_end, or subscription_status.
findings.classification: The spec references 'the existing if existing branch at lines 443-482' from the pre-implementation code. The implementation chose a simpler approach: update only amount/currency (which were nil from checkout), then delegate credit granting to ApplyAiCreditPurchase. Period dates and status are NOT updated by this handler. This means subscription purchases will have nil period dates and nil status after invoice.paid. This is a design choice consistent with the cleanup that removed the customer.subscription.updated handler.
findings.recommendation: Report only. The subscription period dates would need to be populated if subscription management UI is built, but that is out of scope for Phase 1.

findings.title: No charge.refunded handler for credit packs
findings.spec_requirement: Note #33 confirmed no change needed, but the handler existed pre-cleanup
findings.evidence: The cleanup removed the charge.refunded handler and handle_charge_refunded method. Note #33 in approved decisions says 'No change' meaning keep it as-is. However, the original code was out-of-spec code added by a fix agent. The approved decision was about the pre-existing charge.refunded handler, not the fix agent's version.
findings.classification: The charge.refunded handler was part of the original codebase additions. Note #33 said 'No change' to the behavior described in note #33 (silently dropping unmatched refunds). The removal of charge.refunded handling means credit pack refunds will not be processed automatically. This is consistent with the spec's scope -- refund handling was not part of the Phase 1 changes spec.
findings.recommendation: Report only. Refund handling is outside Phase 1 scope.

findings.title: checkout action sets amount_cents_paid: 0 instead of leaving nil
findings.spec_requirement: Note #9B-5: amount_cents_paid and currency are currently unconditionally required. The relaxation defers their requirement until after the subscription is linked.
findings.evidence: organization_ai_credit_purchases_controller.rb line 53: amount_cents_paid: 0. The validation at line 69-72 says 'unless subscription? && stripe_subscription_id.blank?' which would allow nil. Setting 0 is defensively consistent but differs from spec's implication of nil.
findings.classification: Spec-compliant. The validation allows either approach (nil when subscription without stripe_subscription_id, or 0). Both work.
